en: Focus the client's attention on the boat neckline: an ideal canvas for showcasing a necklace from the new collection or a silk neck scarf, which helps increase the average basket value.
Emphasise the fabric composition: 70% natural wool guarantees warmth and longevity, an important factor when investing in a winter wardrobe.
Draw attention to the textured knit: the cable pattern is an enduring symbol of winter luxury, adding a sense of cosiness to the look without compromising its elegance.
